author: New China TV
description:
200 captive-bred sea turtles have been released off the coast of south China's Guangdong. Several were fitted with Beidou satellite trackers, including one with a vision-integrated smart tracker that allows researchers to monitor behavior, verify data, and better understand the local ecology.
#SeaTurtleRelease #BeidouSatellite #WildlifeConservation #MarineEcology #Guangdong
title: China's Beidou satellite system helps track sea turtles released into ocean

author: New China TV
description: An influencer from the Dominican Republic with 4.46M followers, Chelsy Bautista explores Chongqing, a city often described as a real-life cyberpunk metropolis in China. From ancient cultural relics nestled among towering skyscrapers to sweeping rooftop views over dramatic river confluences, she experiences a place where tradition, everyday life, and futuristic urban design seamlessly collide. Xinhua presents this first-person journey through one of the world’s most cinematic urban landscapes. (recorded)
title: Inside Chongqing: Influencer from the Dominican Republic explores China's cyberpunk city

description: People found a juvenile grey-capped greenfinch by the roadside in Yan'an, northwest China's Shaanxi Province. They gently placed it in an artificial nest. Soon after, a parent bird arrived, reuniting the family. #KindHeartedRescue #GreyCappedGreenfinch #WildlifeCare
title: Lost greenfinch placed in artificial nest, reunited with parent

#HulunbuirGrassland #InnerMongolia #Wildlife #EcoProtection

author: New China TV
description:
A flock of gray cranes was spotted roaming the Gahai wetland in northwest China's Gansu Province, joining other waterbirds in a vibrant display of life across the plateau wetland.
Located in the upper reaches of the Yellow River, the Gahai wetland has become an important habitat for migratory birds after years of ecological restoration and wetland protection efforts.
title: Gray cranes roam plateau wetland in northwest China
